# DeepSeek V4 Guide

> An independent tutorial hub helping developers and beginners access, cost-optimize, and integrate DeepSeek V4 Flash & Pro. All content is researched and sourced; prices and benchmarks are labeled with their as-of date.

## What this site covers

- DeepSeek V4 Flash & Pro: what they are, the July 31, 2026 official release, pricing, benchmarks
- How to use DeepSeek V4: official API, OpenCode, OpenCode Go, OpenRouter, Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, CC Switch
- Local deployment: HuggingFace weights, model size, VRAM, vLLM
- Ecosystem news: DeepSeek Harness, V4 Pro GA timeline, comparisons
